synopsis: CSA M424 is identified as the relevant Canadian national standard series for mining machinery, published by CSA Group, formerly the Canadian Standards Association [f15525, f15527, f15028]. Canadian mining regulation operates province by province, so the national standard sits alongside provincial requirements [f15525]. However, the booklet did not verify either CSA M424 or Canadian provincial mining regulations; this gap appears in both Chapter 3 and the glossary [f2252, f15528, f15028]. Consequently, the corpus identifies the standard’s role but does not establish its requirements for automatic braking [f15525, f2252].

relations.note: Both report that CSA M424 and Canadian provincial regulations were not verified.
Both report the lack of CSA M424 verification.
Both repeat the CSA M424 verification gap.
Both identify CSA M424 as a CSA Group standard for mining machinery.
Adds CSA M424’s national role alongside province-by-province Canadian mining regulation.
